safety.source: Plant Therapy product page: 'Dilute to 2-5% in a carrier', listed KidSafe and Pregnancy Safe, no sun caution (https://www.planttherapy.com/products/sweet-orange-essential-oil). Not on the Tisserand Institute phototoxic limits table (https://tisserandinstitute.org/safety/phototoxicity/). Cat caution from Plant Therapy, 'Essential Oils and Cats' (https://www.planttherapy.com/blogs/blog/essential-oils-and-cats). Fast-oxidizing flag from the PLAN.md safety table. Read Nov 2026.

Plant Therapy product page (cold-pressed): 'Lemon Essential Oil is phototoxic. Do not exceed 2% in leave-on topical formulations', 'Maximum dilution of 2% for topical applications', listed KidSafe and Pregnancy Safe (https://www.planttherapy.com/products/lemon-essential-oil). Lemon (expressed) 2.0% on the Tisserand Institute phototoxic limits table (https://tisserandinstitute.org/safety/phototoxicity/). Cat caution from Plant Therapy, 'Essential Oils and Cats' (https://www.planttherapy.com/blogs/blog/essential-oils-and-cats). Fast-oxidizing flag from the PLAN.md safety table. Read Nov 2026.

Plant Therapy product page: 'Pink Grapefruit can cause photosensitivity. To avoid this, we recommend a dilution no higher than 4%', listed KidSafe and Pregnancy Safe (https://www.planttherapy.com/products/pink-grapefruit-essential-oil). Grapefruit (expressed) 4.0% on the Tisserand Institute phototoxic limits table (https://tisserandinstitute.org/safety/phototoxicity/). Cat caution from Plant Therapy, 'Essential Oils and Cats' (https://www.planttherapy.com/blogs/blog/essential-oils-and-cats). Fast-oxidizing flag from the PLAN.md safety table. Read Nov 2026.

Bergamot 0.4% on the Tisserand Institute phototoxic limits table (https://tisserandinstitute.org/safety/phototoxicity/). Plant Therapy's product page is inconsistent: it says its Bergamot 'is free of bergapten' and also says 'If applied on the skin, ensure limited sun exposure', so the standard bergamot limit is used here. Check your bottle: if it says bergapten-free or FCF, the sun limit does not apply.
